summary: Bake deterministic groom-depth occlusion for clump diagnostics and hair-card red self-shadow.
x-method: A worker-local spatial index covers swept clump covariance ellipsoids. Depth in each clump contributes at most once, combined with proximity to the prepared head/body SDF. This is a groom-depth approximation, not ray-traced hemisphere visibility. The same field darkens diagnostic clump colours and supplies card vertex red, where 1 means buried and darker in hair.mt.
x-budget: Build once per generation, query only generated vertices, record bake milliseconds separately. No screen-space effect, main-thread bake, authored geometry or new source reads.
x-tests: Exposed points have less occlusion than buried points; overlapping clumps increase burial; values are finite in [0,1], deterministic and independent of view. Source geometry and material profiles are unchanged.
x-coarse: Only a matching continuation and unchanged card/volume topology may reuse the previous completed occlusion bake for coarse feedback. Final output always rebakes the new geometry. Cache keys include the complete previous groom and surface revision; withdrawal ends the worker cache.
x-shadow: Generated cards enable the existing hair.mt baked self-shadow at strength 0.65 while retaining V’s profile and the template’s ShadowMin/ShadowMax. Red is the generated occlusion field, not a colour multiplier.
